issues.display_title: Issue #3121: Design Publish Bookmark Modal for Bookmark Detail Page
issues.main_description_html:
Design Publish Bookmark Modal for Bookmark Detail Page

RESULT

Source

  • Brainstorming document: docs/brainstorming/publish-bookmark-detail-layout-brainstorming.md
  • Target repo: GoThruMedia/panorra-pwa
  • Target project board: GoThruMedia Project 31, To Do

Summary

Create the UI/UX design task for publishing a draft bookmark from the bookmark detail page.

The user opens a draft bookmark, reviews the saved posts, and presses Publish bookmark. The system opens a modal where the user must complete all required public bookmark details before publishing.

Required Experience

  • Add a visible draft/published state to the bookmark detail page.
  • Show a Publish bookmark action only for draft bookmarks.
  • Open a Publish bookmark modal from the bookmark detail page.
  • Use a guided single-modal layout, not a separate page or multi-step wizard.
  • Keep the design compact, product-native, and consistent with Panorra bookmark/settings UI.

Modal Requirements

The modal must include these required fields:

  • Cover selected from saved bookmark posts.
  • Title.
  • Description.
  • Location/address.
  • Latitude.
  • Longitude.
  • Category.

Allowed categories:

  • Leisure.
  • Real Estate.
  • Business.

States To Design

  • Default empty/draft state.
  • Ready state when all required fields are complete.
  • Loading state while publishing.
  • Success state after publishing.
  • Error state when publishing fails.
  • No saved posts state.
  • Address search unavailable/offline state.
  • Unsaved changes confirmation state.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Bookmark detail includes visible Draft or Published status.
  • Draft bookmark detail includes a Publish bookmark action.
  • Publish action opens a modal.
  • Modal shows cover selection before text fields.
  • Cover selection uses thumbnails from saved bookmark posts.
  • Selected cover state is clear and does not rely only on color.
  • Title, description, location/address, latitude, longitude, and category are all required.
  • Publish button is disabled until all required fields are complete.
  • Field-level validation messages are shown near each invalid field.
  • Modal keeps entered data after publish failure.
  • Desktop layout uses a comfortable modal with sticky footer actions.
  • Mobile layout works as a bottom sheet or near-full-screen modal.
  • All controls are touch-friendly and keyboard accessible.
  • UI follows the design instructions from the brainstorming document.

Design Notes

  • Recommended direction: Guided Publishing Modal.
  • Strongest visual priority: make the selected cover easy to recognize.
  • Do not use a marketing hero layout.
  • Do not use nested cards.
  • Do not make categories look optional.
  • Do not rely on placeholder text as the only label.
